summary: Tested the chunked video upload stored in Mongo (backend and UI), the seasonal arcade catalog, and the GamePicker filters in the Contest editor and Free World GC settings. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed against the public URL. UI: all checks passed. Nothing was saved to settings, contests or GC configs.

minor.issue: Abandoned upload sessions and their chunks (up to 120MB each) are never cleaned up. There is no TTL index, and chunk docs have no created_at. Add created_at to chunks and a TTL index on both collections (e.g. 1h).
The section comment still says 'max 60 MB / 30 seconds'. The code allows 120MB / 60.5s.

design_issues.screen: Admin > GC Competition Settings level cards
issues: The GamePicker filters wrap badly in the narrow Game column: the theme select drops onto its own line under the search and style fields. Consider stacking the filters full-width or giving the Game column more space.

action_items: Optional: add a TTL cleanup for video_upload_sessions / video_upload_chunks

Optional: SettingsPage videoDuration() rejects any file the browser cannot decode (e.g. HEVC .mov in Chrome on Windows or Linux) with 'Could not read this video.' Consider a fallback, e.g. let the server accept these files or show a clearer message.
Optional: fix the stale comment and the GC picker filter wrapping
critical_code_review_comments: complete_video_upload deletes the session in finally, even on a 400 'incomplete' error. This matches the spec, but the client cannot resume and must restart the whole upload.
All chunks are joined in memory (up to 120MB per request). Acceptable, but watch pod memory if several uploads run at once.
seed_data_creation: None in the DB. Uploaded to R2: one 5MB fake mp4 (pytest) and one ~3KB webm (UI test), both under promotions/videos/. No settings were saved, and Mongo upload collections are empty after the tests (0/0).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The /app/backend/tests conftest forces an isolated loopback backend, so tests against the public URL are skipped there. To run test_video_upload_and_seasonal_games.py against the public URL: copy it to /tmp/t55, add an empty pytest.ini, and run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL set. Verified: start validation returns 400/413/415 and rejects unauthenticated calls with 401/403. A 3-chunk 5MB upload returns a public R2 URL (HEAD 200), and a second complete returns 404. A missing chunk returns 400 'Upload incomplete'. An oversized chunk returns 400. /api/games/types returns 190 games, 160 of them arcade. UI: the slide input accept attr is correct, and a browser-generated webm uploads through start, chunk and complete with 200s and shows a preview. In both Contest (New dialog) and GC pickers: 22 style options and 9 theme options (including Christmas Magic, Halloween Night, Summer Splash); Balloon Pop + Christmas Magic leaves 1 option; searching 'safe cracker' gives 8; 'Classic games' gives 30; the selected value stays selected under a non-matching filter. Note: the Edit dialog hides the game section for contests whose engine is not leaderboard.
